units.title: Trigonometric identities and equations
units.why: Identities allow equivalent forms to be proved and equations to be solved across an interval.
principles: solutions repeat by the function period
misconceptions: giving only one solution on a full interval
dividing by an expression that may be zero
practice: Rewrite tanθ using sin and cos.
quizQuestions: Why are there two sine solutions?

videoPackage.title: Identities and full-interval solutions
videoPackage.transcript: We simplify with identities, locate all angles on the interval, and use the graph to check that no solution has been missed.
